policy.context_layer: always available; hierarchical 64-token self-attention + summary bank
policy.projection_layer: one resident field_driver VM for byte/word/token table heads
policy.host_role: load images, transport arguments, forward receipts
policy.guest_role: all counts, interpolation, top-k, loss, context math

switching: context() lazily constructs the persistent context layer; projection load(kind) selects a field_driver table head. There is no context Kind or context mode.
note: One system runtime API. Context and projection use distinct native worker images because 16 head-page slots and the projection count arena do not share a physical layout.
